name: PI-Desktop
description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
one_liner: A desktop app that gives AI coding assistants their own workspace — like a control room where you can watch, review, and manage multiple AI coding sessions across projects.
buyer: A professional software developer or small dev team already paying for AI coding tools who wants one workspace instead of juggling terminals and editor plugins.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes internal AI-assisted workflows on it to give clients visibility into which AI changes were reviewed and approved.
A solo indie developer runs several AI agents on side projects in parallel, using it as mission control instead of multiple terminal windows.
A coding bootcamp uses it to teach students how to safely review and approve AI-generated code changes.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell premium plugins/panels (analytics, team dashboards, compliance logging) on top of the free open-source core.
Offer a hosted 'team' tier with shared session history and permissions for companies.

steal_this: This is a crowded, well-funded category (competes with Cursor, established IDEs) — not a realistic weekend clone; the real opportunity is building one paid plugin for it, not the app itself.
